# Quarto introduction

## Quarto

Quarto is a document generation tool that allows to create documents in different formats (pdf, html, docx, etc.) using markdown and R code.

![](images/quarto.png){width="30%" fig-align="center"}

In CUNEF University - Machine Learning subjects we are going to use quarto to generate presentations and material for our students.

# Code

## Python Code

```{python}
# This is a Python code block
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r = np.arange(0, 2, 0.01)
theta = 2 * np.pi * r
fig, ax = plt.subplots(
  subplot_kw = {'projection': 'polar'}
)
ax.plot(theta, r)
ax.set_rticks([0.5, 1, 1.5, 2])
ax.grid(True)
plt.show()
```


## R Code

```{r}
# This is a R code block
#| label: fig-airquality
#| fig-cap: "Temperature and ozone level."
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(airquality, aes(Temp, Ozone)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess")
```


## Highlighted code

```{python}
#| code-line-numbers: "3-5"
a = 1
b = 2
c = a + b
d = a - b
e = c - d
print(e)
```

## Code configuration

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

Code solution without code:

```{python}
#| code-fold: true

b = 2
c = a + b
print(c)
```

# Extra content

## Tables

Tables are made with markdown (do not know why to set it in external, sorry):

| Right | Left | Default | Center |
|------:|:-----|---------|:------:|
|   12  |  12  |    12   |    12  |
|  123  |  123 |   123   |   123  |
|    1  |    1 |     1   |     1  |


## Maths

Math is done with latex:

Inline math $\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ and block math:

$$E = mc^{2}$$

## Diagrams

Diagrams are made by mermaid:

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
flowchart LR
  A[Hard edge] --> B(Round edge)
  B --> C{Decision}
  C --> D[Result one]
  C --> E[Result two]
```

# Style

Title slide style

## Non stilish slide

Style of a slide without specific style

## Stlish slide {.novel}

The css style could also be used in title slides `#Title {.inh_novel}` to be applied the tag `novel` to every slide below.
